name: MacARM Input Buffer
description: Holds early jump clicks until a ground jump or orb click is legal. Optional uniform wave input delay and wave input guard.

assist-enabled.name: Enabled
assist-enabled.description: Swallow early jump clicks and press once a jump is legal.

practice-only.name: Practice Mode only
practice-only.description: When on, the assist does nothing outside Practice Mode.

window-frames.name: Cube window (display frames)
window-frames.description: How many rendered frames an early cube/ball/robot/spider click stays active. 1 = vanilla.

wave-delay.name: Wave input delay (display frames)
wave-delay.description: Delays wave presses and releases equally. This is pure input lag, not an early-click window. 0 = off.

wave-guard.name: Wave input guard
wave-guard.description: Drops duplicate wave presses and releases a stuck hold only when the physical button is up. Never presses for you.
